stem.text: A bicycle gear wheel is a disc with 50 ‘teeth’ equally spaced around its edge, as shown. The gear wheel is rotated 10 times each second. A springy strip of metal is vibrated by the rotating ‘teeth’. The metal strip produces a sound of frequency that is equal to the frequency of vibration of the strip.

stem.alt: Gear wheel with teeth around its edge, labelled gear wheel and teeth; a springy strip of metal held by a fixed clamp, with its free end close to the teeth.

stem.text: The speed of sound in air is $330\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.
What is the wavelength of the emitted sound?
